start_here: Say to your AI: "Give me the RSS feed of my articles." It runs tool:read-the-articles-feed and answers the feed text.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the published articles and writes the feed text, changing nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the rows, such as example_for_who_uses_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:read-the-articles-feed and the input.
3. Read the answer: the feed as xml text. Show it with the screen the tool names.
